items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: It was made as a single, with that tune "Martinique" that the DeParis brothers...

ctx.x: How big a hit was that?

Oh, man, it was a terrific hit. It was sensational. What happened was that the recording company that made it, Lark Records, they sent... It was made as a single, with that tune "Martinique" that the DeParis brothers... They put it on the back of that. Instead of my putting my "Louisiana, Ay-Ai(?)" on the back of that, I made a zillion dollars in royalties on top of "Yellow Dog," you see -- but we put "Martinique" anyway. Both of them was a hit.
